stories.title: "Absolutely mogged": Trump flinches at a flyover as Xi stands still
stories.summary: At Xi Jinping's arrival ceremony at Joint Base Andrews, two B-1 bombers roared overhead during the US national anthem. Trump, mid-salute, winced, gritted his teeth and ducked; Xi barely moved. "That was loud," Trump told him afterwards. MeidasTouch's clip (36K likes) was quoted with two words, "Absolutely mogged" (159K), and the riffs followed: "Hang it in the Louvre," and a meme of Marco Rubio leaning in to whisper, "Sir, Xi didn't flinch at all."
